request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: book covers and spines are plain solid colors, menus and signs are blank, and any screen shows only soft abstract color with no text, faces or recognizable show. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the person, both hands and the object of the action inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

The action is the most obvious thing in the photo: the camera is at eye level a few steps away, the face is fully visible in three-quarter view and in sharp focus, and the person is seen from the head to the waist or lower, with the hands and the object clearly visible. The person is busy with the action and does not look at the camera.

It is clearly EVENING after dark: every window shows a deep blue evening sky, and warm indoor lamps light the room and the person's face. No daylight anywhere.

Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, skin tone and build exactly, and his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph in a small, quiet neighborhood restaurant in the evening, clearly NOT a home: Diego sits alone at a small square table with a white tablecloth and eats dinner, a fork in his hand lifting a bite from a full plate of rice, chicken and green vegetables; a glass of water and a folded napkin stand beside the plate. Behind him, several other small tables with chairs stand empty, warm pendant lamps hang from the ceiling and a wooden service counter is softly visible; the big front window shows the dark blue evening street. There is no stove, no pot and no cooking anywhere in the photo.
